answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 14696 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Assalamu alaikum Mufti saab; i have a question regarding the UMRAH.i live in Riyadh. I went to makkah to perform UMRAH. I completed my UMRAH there and then went to Jeddah to see my relatives but while returnign i came back to Makkah and immediately got the bus to riyadh. Kindly please advice if i had to perform UMRAH since i came from Jeddah to board the bus in Makkah. If yes, then please advice what should i do now since i have not preformed the later UMRAH. Question: Assalamu alaikum Mufti saab; i have a question regarding the UMRAH.i live in Riyadh. I went to makkah to perform UMRAH. I completed my UMRAH there and then went to Jeddah to see my relatives but while returnign i came back to Makkah and immediately got the bus to riyadh. Kindly please advice if i had to perform UMRAH since i came from Jeddah to board the bus in Makkah. If yes, then please advice what should i do now since i have not preformed the later UMRAH. Answer ID: 14696 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1247/1185=B/1430) When you came Makkah from Jeddah just to ride a bus, you were not required to wear ihram. Neither you wore ihram nor performed umrah, then there is no dam (sacrifice of animal) on you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
